questions.title: Question 1: Venn Diagram Set Analysis, Fraction Operations & Rational Equations
questions.diagramSvg: <svg viewBox='0 0 360 190' width='100%' height='180' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><rect width='350' height='180' x='5' y='5' rx='8' fill='#f8fafc' stroke='#334155' stroke-width='2'/><text x='18' y='28' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='13' font-weight='bold' fill='#0f172a'>U = 42</text><circle cx='135' cy='105' r='60' fill='none' stroke='#2563eb' stroke-width='2'/><circle cx='225' cy='105' r='60' fill='none' stroke='#059669' stroke-width='2'/><text x='90' y='45' font-size='12' font-weight='bold' fill='#2563eb'>History (H: 26)</text><text x='205' y='45' font-size='12' font-weight='bold' fill='#059669'>Geography (G: 22)</text><text x='95' y='110' font-size='12' fill='#1e293b'>26 - x</text><text x='175' y='110' font-size='13' font-weight='bold' fill='#dc2626'>x</text><text x='235' y='110' font-size='12' fill='#1e293b'>22 - x</text><text x='25' y='165' font-size='11' fill='#64748b'>Neither = 4</text></svg>

parts.prompt:
In a class of $42$ students, $26$ study History, $22$ study Geography, and $4$ study neither subject.
Using the Venn diagram provided above:
(i) Formulate an algebraic equation connecting the subsets.
(ii) Find the number of students who study **both** subjects.
(iii) Calculate the number of students who study History **only**.
parts.hint: Sum of all disjoint subsets and those outside both circles equals 42: $(26 - x) + x + (22 - x) + 4 = 42$.
parts.workedSolution:
**(i) Algebraic Equation:**
$$(26 - x) + x + (22 - x) + 4 = 42$$
$$52 - x = 42$$

**(ii) Students studying both subjects ($x$):**
$$x = 52 - 42 = 10\text{ students}$$

**(iii) Students studying History only:**
$$\text{History only} = 26 - x = 26 - 10 = 16\text{ students}$$.

parts.hint: Combine whole numbers and fractional parts using a common denominator of 12.
parts.workedSolution:
**Method: Combining whole numbers and fractional parts**
$$= (3 - 1 + 2) + \left(\frac{1}{2} - \frac{2}{3} + \frac{1}{4}\right)$$
$$= 4 + \left(\frac{6 - 8 + 3}{12}\right)$$
$$= 4 + \frac{1}{12} = 4\frac{1}{12}$$
*(Or as improper fraction: $\frac{49}{12}$)*.

parts.hint: Multiply both sides by 12 (the LCM of 4 and 3) to eliminate fractions.

questions.title: Question 2: Ratio Sharing, Simple Interest & Base Five Conversion

parts.prompt:
Three partners, Mensah, Boateng, and Asare, shared an investment return of $\text{GH¢ } 3,000.00$ in the ratio $2 : 3 : 5$ respectively.
(i) Calculate the share of each partner.
(ii) What percentage of the total return did Asare receive?
parts.hint: Total ratio units = 2 + 3 + 5 = 10. Value of 1 unit = 3000 / 10.
parts.modelAnswer: (i) Mensah: GH¢ 600.00, Boateng: GH¢ 900.00, Asare: GH¢ 1,500.00; (ii) 50%
parts.workedSolution:
**(i) Share Distribution:**
Total units = $2 + 3 + 5 = 10$.
Value of 1 unit = $$\frac{\text{GH¢ } 3,000.00}{10} = \text{GH¢ } 300.00$$
- **Mensah:** $$2 \times 300.00 = \text{GH¢ } 600.00$$
- **Boateng:** $$3 \times 300.00 = \text{GH¢ } 900.00$$
- **Asare:** $$5 \times 300.00 = \text{GH¢ } 1,500.00$$

**(ii) Asare's percentage share:**
$$\text{Percentage} = \left(\frac{5}{10}\right) \times 100\% = 50\%$$.

parts.prompt: Boateng invested his share of $\text{GH¢ } 900.00$ at a simple interest rate of $8\%\text{ per annum}$ for $3\text{ years}$. Calculate the total amount he had in his account at the end of the $3\text{ years}$.
parts.hint: $$I = \frac{P \times R \times T}{100}$$. Total Amount = Principal + Simple Interest.

parts.prompt: Convert the decimal number $94_{\text{ten}}$ to a base five numeral.
parts.workedSolution:
$$94 \div 5 = 18\text{ R } 4$$
$$18 \div 5 = 3\text{ R } 3$$
$$3 \div 5 = 0\text{ R } 3$$
Reading remainders upwards gives: **$$334_{\text{five}}$$**.

parts.hint: Substitute each missing x value into $y_1 = 2x + 1$ and $y_2 = 4 - x$.

parts.prompt:
From the simultaneous graph above, determine:
(i) The coordinates of the point where the two lines intersect.
(ii) The gradient of the line $y_1 = 2x + 1$.
parts.hint: Set $2x + 1 = 4 - x$ to solve for $x$, then find $y$. Gradient is the coefficient of $x$.
parts.workedSolution:
**(i) Point of intersection:**
$$2x + 1 = 4 - x$$
$$2x + x = 4 - 1$$
$$3x = 3 \implies x = 1$$
When $x = 1$, $y = 2(1) + 1 = 3$. Point of intersection is **$(1, 3)$**.

**(ii) Gradient:**
$y_1 = 2x + 1 \implies m = 2$.

parts.prompt: Find the truth set of the inequality: $$2x + 1 \ge 4 - x$$.
parts.workedSolution:
$$2x + x \ge 4 - 1$$
$$3x \ge 3 \implies x \ge 1$$
Truth set: **$$\{x : x \ge 1, \, x \in \mathbb{R}\}$$**.

questions.title: Question 5: Rectangular Water Reservoir Capacity, Surface Area & Depth
questions.diagramSvg: <svg viewBox='0 0 350 220' width='100%' height='200' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><rect x='30' y='70' width='170' height='110' fill='#eff6ff' stroke='#1e40af' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M30,70 L80,30 L250,30 L200,70 Z' fill='#dbeafe' stroke='#1e40af' stroke-width='1.5'/><path d='M200,70 L250,30 L250,140 L200,180 Z' fill='#bfdbfe' stroke='#1e40af' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='100' y='200' font-size='12' font-weight='bold'>l = 7 m</text><text x='235' y='165' font-size='12' font-weight='bold'>w = 4 m</text><text x='5' y='130' font-size='12' font-weight='bold'>h = 3 m</text><line x1='30' y1='120' x2='200' y2='120' stroke='#0284c7' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-dasharray='4'/><line x1='200' y1='120' x2='250' y2='80' stroke='#0284c7' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-dasharray='4'/><text x='85' y='145' font-size='11' fill='#0369a1' font-weight='bold'>Water Volume = 56 m³</text></svg>

parts.prompt:
A closed rectangular water reservoir has length $7\text{ m}$, width $4\text{ m}$, and height $3\text{ m}$ as shown above.
Calculate the **total surface area** of the reservoir when completely enclosed.
Calculate the **total capacity** of the reservoir in cubic metres ($\text{m}^3$) and convert your answer to litres, given that $1\text{ m}^3 = 1,000\text{ litres}$.
parts.hint: Volume = length × width × height. Multiply volume by 1,000 to get litres.
parts.workedSolution:
$$V = l \times w \times h = 7\text{ m} \times 4\text{ m} \times 3\text{ m} = 84\text{ m}^3$$
$$\text{Capacity in litres} = 84 \times 1,000 = 84,000\text{ litres}$$.

parts.prompt: If $56\text{ m}^3$ of water is pumped into the empty reservoir, calculate the depth ($d$) of the water.
parts.workedSolution:
$$\text{Base area} = 7 \times 4 = 28\text{ m}^2$$
$$d = \frac{56}{28} = 2\text{ m}$$
Therefore, the depth of the water is **$2\text{ m}$**.

parts.prompt:
The test scores of $20$ pupils in a mathematics quiz are recorded in the bar chart above:

| Mark ($x$) | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| Frequency ($f$) | 2 | 4 | 8 | 3 | 2 | 1 |

(i) State the **modal mark**.
(ii) Find the total number of pupils ($N = \sum f$).
(iii) Calculate the **mean mark** of the class.
parts.hint: Mode is the mark with highest frequency. Mean = $\sum fx / \sum f$.
parts.workedSolution:
**(i) Modal mark:**
The highest frequency is $8$, corresponding to mark **3**.

**(ii) Total pupils:**
$$N = \sum f = 2 + 4 + 8 + 3 + 2 + 1 = 20\text{ pupils}$$

**(iii) Mean mark:**
$$\sum fx = (1 \times 2) + (2 \times 4) + (3 \times 8) + (4 \times 3) + (5 \times 2) + (6 \times 1)$$
$$\sum fx = 2 + 8 + 24 + 12 + 10 + 6 = 62$$
$$\text{Mean} = \frac{\sum fx}{\sum f} = \frac{62}{20} = 3.1\text{ marks}$$.

parts.prompt:
If a pupil is chosen at random from this group:
(i) Find the probability that the pupil scored strictly more than $3\text{ marks}$.
(ii) What percentage of the class scored at least $2\text{ marks}$?
parts.hint: Scores > 3 are 4, 5, 6. At least 2 means scores 2, 3, 4, 5, 6.
parts.workedSolution:
**(i) Probability of scoring > 3 (marks 4, 5, 6):**
$$\text{Count} = f(4) + f(5) + f(6) = 3 + 2 + 1 = 6$$
$$P(x > 3) = \frac{6}{20} = \frac{3}{10}$$

**(ii) Percentage scoring at least 2 (marks 2, 3, 4, 5, 6):**
$$\text{Count} = 20 - f(1) = 20 - 2 = 18$$
$$\text{Percentage} = \left(\frac{18}{20}\right) \times 100\% = 18 \times 5 = 90\%$$.
